posters.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished Chinese Xiaohongshu promotional poster, portrait 3:4, 1536 x 2048 if possible, for the NEW Obsidian note saving feature of Flow Paper.
Input 1: an authentic Flow Paper app screenshot reading the public paper Attention Is All You Need, with a real model reply and the 加入笔记 control. Supporting compositing input, preserve the real product UI as faithfully as possible; crop it for legibility rather than invent UI.
Input 2: an authentic Obsidian screenshot of the same question, figure and answer saved in one paper note in a clean demo vault. Supporting compositing input. Keep recognizable actual Obsidian UI, the Transformer figure, note title, research/论文 folder and original-page link. Only demo data.
Input 3: actual Flow Paper brand icon. Preserve this exact flat blue icon design.
Art direction: a thoughtful independent Mac app release poster, warm off-white background, deep navy typography, soft periwinkle-purple emphasis for Obsidian and one restrained pale yellow highlighter. Crisp typography, disciplined editorial layout, elegant and useful, no AI robot, neon, fake 3D computer, decorative dashboard cards or noisy doodles. Match a serious academic reading tool with some warmth.
Layout: compact icon + Flow Paper masthead at top, small label 笔记更新 and page number 01. Bold two-line headline occupying only the top quarter. A concise subtitle. The middle/lower 60% is a visual story using TWO large straight-on crops from the authentic screenshots: Flow Paper question with the 加入笔记 action visible, then Obsidian note showing the saved figure and answer. Use an understated connecting line/arrow with labels “读论文 · 提问” and “加入笔记 → Obsidian”. Ensure each screenshot crop has usable readable size, do not shrink full windows into postage stamps; crop away empty margins. Preserve actual UI instead of reimagining it. Bottom one concise capability line and GitHub URL.
EXACT EXTERNAL COPY, no extra slogans:
“Flow Paper”
“笔记更新”
“边读边问，”
“笔记进 Obsidian。”
“点一次「加入笔记」，问答、截图、出处一起留存。”
“读论文 · 提问”
“加入笔记 → Obsidian”
“一篇论文一个 Markdown · 沿用你的论文模板”
“开源 · Mac · Apple 芯片”
“github.com/xyizhan/flow-paper”
Fine print: “公开论文与示范笔记库 · 基于真机截图排版”
Small attribution: “论文：Vaswani 等，Attention Is All You Need（2017）”
Page number “01”.
Truth constraints: only explicitly saved answers go to notes; never claim all conversations autosave. No automatic summarization/template completion claim. No cloud synchronization claim. No unqualified zero-conflict claim. No private accounts, home-directory paths, unrelated paper names or secret keys. Keep visible demo folder names only. Do not add a QR code.
